race.title: Midnight A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
race.verdict: EIGHTY EIGHT built on a promising stable debut to win comfortably at Chelmsford 18 days ago and remains well treated despite a 5 lb rise. Token Love produced his best effort when second over C&D 21 days ago and can again be in the mix, while Beachborough Girl won here in June off this mark. EIGHTY EIGHT (IRE) TOKEN LOVE (FR) BEACHBOROUGH GIRL
